name: Danny Elliott Park (Oswego)
note: City of Oswego river park on the north bank of the Neosho, across the Xavier Road bridge from town and below the bluff Kamp Siesta sits on, beside the low weir: four sites strung along a gravel spur beside an open picnic lawn. No restroom here and the city gives no pad length; the dump station and the pay drop box are at Kamp Siesta. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Oswego 'RV Parks' page (current: carries the 2026 fair dates), read 2026-11-06: 'Oswego has two RV Parks - Kamp Siesta (part of Riverside Park) and a 4 site area in Danny Elliott Park'; 'Danny Elliott Park - 1275 Xavier Road ... located on the north bank of the Neosho River just below Riverside Park. Four camping sites with electric and water hook-up and concrete pads are available. A dump station is available at Kamp Siesta ... as well as a drop box for payments'; Esri imagery 2017-03-02 and 2023-10-23 show a drive-in gravel spur and turnaround off Xavier Rd with small concrete pads along its west edge -> city RV camping area (public presence ladder step 1; no price gate). Separate place from 13524 Kamp Siesta: ~420 m away but across the Neosho, entered from Xavier Rd north of the river bridge (Kamp Siesta is off North St on the bluff south of the river).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-06: Esri World Imagery 2023-10-23 (z19 frames at 37.17675,-95.10335 and 37.1775,-95.1040, plus a 500 m frame, all rendered) and Esri Wayback leaf-off 2017-03-02 (z19, same two frames, rendered): the concrete pads sit along the west edge of the gravel spur at ~37.1769-37.1771,-95.1038; between them and the Neosho's weir pool is ~45-60 m of open mowed park lawn (picnic tables/swing set per a Google reviewer) and then a ~10 m brushy bank fringe, patchy bushes and a few trees in 2023, low open brush with the water directly beyond in the leaf-off frame. The lawn is a used day-use picnic ground and the bank fringe partly screens the water, so not riverfront; the water is visible across open ground from the pads -> riverview. The gravel turnaround at the spur's SE end reaches the weir abutment, but the city's sites are the pads, not the turnaround. Not a reservoir: the low weir at the park's SE corner is a river structure with no berm between pads and pool; DEM 249 m at the pads vs 244 m on the pool beside them (Open-Meteo). West side: Xavier Rd and a tree band separate the park from the river's other channel.

fees.note: $15 a night, pay at the drop box at Kamp Siesta or the City Office. Monthly $300 with prior approval.

fees_source: https://www.oswegokansas.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=27&Itemid=28 ('The rate is $15 per night'; Danny Elliott: 'a drop box for payments' at Kamp Siesta), read 2026-11-06; Oswego RV Regulations 'Updated 9-12-16' (https://www.oswegokansas.com/files/2016/RV_REGULATIONSRev_9-12-16(1).pdf, linked from that page): '$15.00 per day whether spots are reserved or on a first come first serve basis', 'Monthly Rate - $300.00 with prior approval'. Shape copied from 13524 Kamp Siesta.

booking.note: Closed to all but Labette County Fair participants from the Saturday before to the Sunday after the fair (July 18-25 in 2026). The city's 2016 RV Regulations take reservations by phone at the City Office, weekdays 8-5; the RV Parks page doesn't say how Danny Elliott's four sites are taken.

booking_source: https://www.oswegokansas.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=27&Itemid=28 ('Labette County Fair is July 18 - 25 for 2026. Both RV parks are closed to everyone except fair participants from the Saturday before thru the Sunday following the fair.'), read 2026-11-06; RV Regulations 9-12-16: 'For reservations call the Oswego City Office at 620-795-4433 Monday thru Friday, 8am to 5 pm.'
rvlife: not listed (RV Life Algolia, 3 km around the pin, 2026-11-06: only Kamp Siesta 11014 and Hillside RV Park 12414)
flags: sites.count 4 -- city RV Parks page 'Four camping sites' / 'a 4 site area in Danny Elliott Park' (read 2026-11-06)

hookups: water true -- city page 'electric and water hook-up'. Electric is present but the city gives no amperage, so electric is NOT written (schema: no amperage = nothing); Campendium/The Dyrt say 30 A (aggregator, unused). No sewer.

facilities: dump NOT on site -- city page 'A dump station is available at Kamp Siesta located in Riverside Park'. facilities left absent (dump:false would be true for the park but the sibling's dump is 400 m away; AWH can stamp it). No restroom on site per a Google reviewer (~2019: 'hook-ups for RVs picnic tables swing set But no bathroom'); Campendium lists a restroom (aggregator) -- toilets/showers not stamped.

booking: not stamped as reservable or FCFS -- the city page says nothing for Danny Elliott; the 2016 regulations (both parks) take phone reservations at $15 'whether spots are reserved or on a first come first serve basis'. CONFLICT on sibling 13524: it stores reservable:false / fcfs:always from the page's Kamp Siesta paragraph, while the same 2016 regulations say 'For reservations call the Oswego City Office'.

pads: 'concrete pads' (city); imagery shows small concrete squares beside a gravel spur, so rigs likely park on the gravel; no length published -> kept with the pad-size caveat (AWH 2026-11-02). No max_rig_ft, no pull-through count.

season: not stated (unknown). Google Maps shows park hours 'Closes 9:30 PM' (listing 4.4 from 23 reviews, no phone, unclaimed, at 37.17667,-95.10319); the city page offers overnight camping regardless.
access: Xavier Rd (RS 1138) bridge over the Neosho, built 1983, good condition (7/9), 27.9 ft deck (bridgelookup.com structure 500530); no posting found. A ~2019 Google review complained of potholes.

currently-operating evidence is the city page itself (current, 2026 fair dates, Danny Elliott paragraph); no dated overnight review found (Google limited view showed 2019-2023 reviews only, fishing/views).
pin moved from Google's 37.17667,-95.10319 (gravel turnaround) to the pad row at 37.17700,-95.10380 (2017 leaf-off concrete squares at 37.17692-37.17709,-95.1038).
waterfront riverview rests on imagery (no city site map): lawn ~45-60 m plus a patchy bank fringe; AWH may prefer not waterfront if the fringe screens more than the leaf-off frame suggests.

duplicate check: only 13524 Kamp Siesta within 2 km (416 m SSW straight-line, but south of the river on the bluff with its entrance off North St); 14537 Hillside RV Park 2.1 km S. Phone and website are the same city page as 13524.
